# Fixtures Book — Test Harness Only

This is a disposable test book used only to validate InkOS audit-dimension
enforcement for the Aethon project's book_rules.md. It is not part of the
Aethon story and its content is throwaway.

Premise: a progression-fantasy blacksmith apprenticeship. Protagonist is
Kael (they/them), an apprentice at a forge under the stern Master Kellan,
alongside fellow apprentice Merin. Apprentices practice "technique
sequences" at the forge (crucible work, tool handling) and advance through
ranks by sitting formal trials; a body called the Registry keeps the
official ledger of who has passed which trial. Multiple short scenes, POV
shifts labelled `— [Name] —`.
